record.title: Prepare an explicit local transport removal gate before reconnect
record.intent: Test the asynchronous removal hypothesis exposed by the preserved reconnect timeout.
requirements: Preserve and independently review the sealed reconnect timeout. Recover the exact disconnect/connect/status chronology, TCP handshake and host closure, absent application payload, recorder statistics and host restoration. Do not infer a scope reboot or root cause from local offline state.

Preserve v3 and prepare a separate minimal adapter with exactly one peer disconnect, bounded local inventory observation until that exact peer is absent, exactly one peer connect, then bounded local inventory observation until the unique peer is device. Retain the original twenty-second total deadline and stop on ambiguity, unexpected state or failure. No epoch read occurs until both local gates pass.

Preserve exclusive call intents, outputs and phase-specific result evidence. Retain the unchanged single process metadata read, mapping checks, original impedance normalization/restoration, lease/isolation, source schedule and all waveform/numerical rules. No daemon restart, root request, physical reboot or specimen setting belongs to the transport adapter.

Validate delayed removal, immediate removal, failed removal, duplicate peer, premature connect and readiness timeout with deterministic host-only controls. Independently review actual concrete preparation and the corresponding minimal completed-arm verifier adaptation. No physical execution belongs to this preparation.
acceptance: The asynchronous-removal hypothesis is prepared for a bounded test or a hold is recorded.
